evals.name: setup-living-mode
evals.prompt: we're a 3-person startup on git. set up documentation rules in this repo so every future claude session follows them. we want the least possible to search through, no old copies lying around.
evals.expected_output: Installer run in general mode with lifecycle living; block appended at end of CLAUDE.md, existing content kept; rules in docs/; no defrost tools.

evals.name: add-interview-source-file
evals.prompt: I interviewed Maya today (12 Oct 2026). My raw notes are in maya-notes.txt in the repo root. Add the interview to our docs properly.
evals.expected_output: One file docs/research/interviews/interview-maya-2026-10-12.md, source: true, lifecycle immutable, Sources section naming Maya and the date, research README updated, no invented quotes.

evals.name: messy-folder-propose-first
evals.prompt: our docs folder is a total mess (competitors_v2, competitors_v3_FINAL, 'Notes Monday', a pdf...). clean it up and make it findable.
evals.expected_output: No files moved/renamed/deleted before approval; a proposal listing renames with what-who-when names and full dates, merging the two competitor copies, a text twin for the PDF, the Monday decision to a decision register.

evals.name: install-and-update-existing-docs
evals.prompt: set up the documentation rules in this repo and bring our existing docs in line with them.
evals.expected_output: Rules installed; every existing doc gets frontmatter/lifecycle and in-place fixes with meaning preserved; renames and moves (notes/Meeting Notes.md) proposed, not executed; docs map lists the docs.
